title: Water Rationing
description: Plain-text guide to survival and sustainable water minimums, four rationing levels from conservation to survival, and ways to cut water use for hygiene, sanitation, and food. Covers children, elders, and nursing mothers, calculating how long supply lasts, dehydration signs, and a daily log.
shortDescription: Four rationing levels, water-saving techniques, and how long supply lasts
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
